data.body: Investigation complete (INTERMEDIATE). ROOT_CAUSE confirmed: cursor gate at bridge-outbound.py:422 is all-or-nothing (counter only increments in success branch). Fix approach: replace counter gate with 'safe high-water mark' — track commits_seen/commits_failed, advance cursor to chronologically-latest commit in (commits_seen − commits_failed) with no earlier commit in commits_failed (resolved via git rev-list reusing _resolve_chunk_head_sha helper). Rejected filer's naive max(success_sha) — unsafe given sort_events_for_dispatch reorders by (ticket_id, type_priority, original_index), not commit graph (silent-drop risk). testing_mode=RED, complexity=MODERATE. User directive: open separate PR per fix commit.
